'''Hathkor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Hathkor appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Planetary Conquest Equipment vendor.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' {{1st}}
